capabilities: Insert wiki-links to person files from @ mentions
Match names with accent-insensitive fuzzy search and initials
Rank suggestions by backlink frequency and note recency
Auto-create person files and folders on selection
Style person links as pills or with custom CSS
extras: Warns that disabling the @ prefix makes every .md file in the people folder appear in suggestions; lists known plugin conflicts over the @ symbol.
intentEvidence: Choose At People if you want a fast, focused solution for person linking.
problem: Obsidian has no chat-style @ mention for people, so linking person notes means typing wikilinks by hand.

relations.evidence: Choose At People if you want a fast, focused solution for person linking.

summary: @-mention plugin that inserts wiki-links to person files with fuzzy, accent-insensitive search and backlink-based ranking.
